description:
As the people who rely on live model choice
  I want each promise to be checked against an input a wrong build would get wrong
  So that a pass means the behaviour is real and the checks can tell right from wrong

elements.name: Two conversations sharing one agent stay independent

steps.name: the stub providers "openai", "bdd-provider-b" and "bdd-provider-c" are configured with models "gpt-5.4-mini", "claude-5-sonnet, claude-5-haiku" and "qwen-5-turbo"
the system default model is "openai/gpt-5.4-mini"
the system default model is "bdd-provider-b/claude-5-haiku"
the conversation "Chat X" and the conversation "Chat Y" both use the agent "Default Assistant"
I switch to the conversation "Chat X"
I set the model override of this conversation to "bdd-provider-c/qwen-5-turbo"
I switch to the conversation "Chat Y"
I send the message "S1 c013"
the reply to "S1 c013" came from "bdd-provider-b/claude-5-haiku"
the agent "Default Assistant" still has no model of its own
the global policy still has no model
